cancel_description: Stock does not change; the document stays cancelled.
description: Approved stock adjustment documents for waste, damage, scrap, loss and found units.
empty_description: Open a document for waste, damage or a found unit.
errors.ADJUSTMENT_EMPTY: Add at least one line first.
errors.ADJUSTMENT_INVALID_STATUS: The document's status does not allow this.
errors.ADJUSTMENT_PHOTO_REQUIRED: A damage document needs at least one photo.
errors.ADJUSTMENT_SELF_APPROVAL: Above the threshold the creator or submitter cannot approve; ask another authorized person.
errors.ADJUSTMENT_STALE: The stock changed since the line was added; remove and add it again.
errors.ADJUSTMENT_UNIT_BUSY: The unit is on another open document, order or transfer.
errors.ADJUSTMENT_UNIT_NOT_ALLOWED: This unit cannot go on this document (not in stock, not voided or the meters do not fit).
errors.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: File storage is not configured; photos cannot be uploaded.
errors.UNIT_NOT_QUARANTINED: This unit is not waiting for inspection here.
hint.photo_required: Add at least one photo to a damage document.
hint.second_approval: Above the threshold: someone with stock adjustment rights other than the creator or submitter approves.
hint.single_approval: Below the threshold: anyone with stock adjustment rights may approve.
lines.empty: No lines yet. Scan or type a barcode.
lines.help: No meters: the whole unit or roll is written off. Meters: that much comes off the roll. Fixed barcodes take a quantity.
lines.help_found: Found: a unit voided before comes back to stock; roll meters or a fixed barcode quantity are added.
lines.meters_invalid: Meters must be above 0 with at most 2 decimals.
lines.title: Lines
load_error: The document could not be loaded.
photos.title: Photos
returns.decision_help.restock: The unit goes back to usable stock; optionally into a bin.
returns.decision_help.scrap: A scrap adjustment document opens; the unit is written off when it is approved.
returns.decision_help.supplier_return: The unit goes back to the supplier and leaves the stock.
returns.description: Received returns wait for inspection; meanwhile they are not counted, picked or used in services.
returns.done.restock: The unit is back in stock.
returns.done.scrap: The scrap document waits for approval.
returns.done.supplier_return: The unit is returned to the supplier.

sections.adjustments.description: Waste, damage, scrap, loss and found documents; a second approval above the threshold.
